tests.scope: existing boundary regression tests, not real-model qualification

route_probe.method: For each rows count, create uint32 random expert IDs in [0,384) of length rows*6; evaluate order=argsort(ids). Compare argsort(order) to put_along_axis(zeros_like(order), order, arange(order.size,dtype=order.dtype),axis=0). Require array_equal; warm each operation five times; record median of 40 perf_counter/mx.eval invocations, including host submission. Operations measured separately; no model loaded.
route_probe.conclusion: Small primitive gain observed, no material end-to-end benefit established; reference-only, no adoption. Not a real-model speedup or numerical qualification.

inference_architecture: logical concurrency with serialized model inference
